intention: Replace charging's hardcoded 62.0 kWh pack capacity with a real, measured value per vehicle. A monthly job INSIDE charging pools each vehicle's valid charge records (USER manual entries and DONE supercharger sessions only, RD2), drops small-delta rows, and stores the median in charging.monthly_effective_capacity keyed on (tesla_id, effective_period). packCapacityKWh reads that table. charging owns every input row, so the derivation lives there too and no cross-module port or import cycle exists (RD1). The wider analytics monthly-metrics table is deferred until a second metric exists (RD12). Linear MAG-32.
request: /kkpa-pickup-linear-ticket MAG-32 — Vehicle Monthly Metrics - New table. Estimate effective capacity per vehicle from MAG-25's inferred_capacity_calc. On the first day of every month, after the nightly job, a named process reads all NOT NULL inferred_capacity_calc values from manual_charge_entries and charge_sessions for the previous month, for every active vehicle, and computes a robust weighted/filtered estimate rather than a simple average. The process may also run for one specific period and one specific tesla id, exposed as an API. effective_capacity will be read by the charging module. Future monthly metrics expected: full_charge_count, average consumption per 100 km, energy consumed per date. Create a KB named vehicle-monthly-metrics.

decisions.decision: charging owns the whole derivation: its own table, its own job, its own read. The earlier PackCapacityReader inverted port is WITHDRAWN. No cross-module port, no import cycle. Supersedes backlog #18.
decisions.why: Every input row belongs to charging, so the derivation does too. The cycle only existed because the job sat in the wrong module.

decisions.decision: Valid input is manual entries with energy_source = 'USER' and supercharger sessions with status = 'DONE'. ESTIMATED entries and DONE_CALCULATED / IN_PROGRESS sessions are excluded.
decisions.why: Those rows had energy or start percentage derived from the 62.0 constant, so their implied capacity is exactly 62.0. Including them averages the constant back into itself.

decisions.decision: Median of valid rows after dropping rows with battery delta under minDeltaPct. Even count averages the two middle values. minSamples = 3, minDeltaPct = 15, both Go constants.
decisions.why: Capacity error scales as 1/delta, so small charges are noise and are dropped, not corrected. Median ignores an outlier with no outlier maths. Constants keep tuning migration-free.

decisions.decision: Under minSamples rows, effective_capacity_kwh stays NULL while sample_count still records what was found. packCapacityKWh takes the newest measured row, else returns 62.0.
decisions.why: A stored number then always means measured, never guessed. Pack capacity moves slowly, so the newest measurement is a good answer for a thin month.

decisions.decision: Keyed on (tesla_id, effective_period) with tesla_id BIGINT NOT NULL. Session rows whose tesla_id is NULL are skipped. No account_id.
decisions.why: manual_charge_entries.tesla_id is already NOT NULL. GROUP BY tesla_id pools accounts automatically. A capacity cannot be attributed to a car nobody registered.

decisions.decision: The trigger is step 4 of app's ProcessVehicleData, after step 3, first day of month only, computing the previous month. Follows the existing step-1 short-circuit.
decisions.why: Makes the ticket's 'must run after the nightly job' true by construction rather than by timing. No second scheduler.

decisions.decision: The month boundary is read through internal/clock in America/Bogota. effective_period stores the first day of the month.
decisions.why: The project rule allows no raw time.Now(), no hardcoded zone and no hand-rolled UTC midnight. make tz-guard enforces it.

decisions.decision: The manual re-run surface is cmd/monthly-capacity with -tesla-id and -period flags. internal/gateway is not touched.
decisions.why: The job is run while debugging or backfilling, not from a screen. An HTTP endpoint would add auth and a JSON error shape for a caller that is only the owner.

decisions.decision: No automatic and no SQL backfill. Past periods are computed by running the tool, wrapped in make cmd-monthly-capacity following the Makefile's cmd-* convention.
decisions.why: Reuses the tool tier 3 already builds. A SQL backfill would write the estimator a second time where it cannot be unit-tested.

decisions.decision: Names: table charging.monthly_effective_capacity, runnable cmd/monthly-capacity, target make cmd-monthly-capacity, KB guide vehicle-monthly-metrics.
decisions.why: The KB keeps the ticket's own name because it documents the whole monthly story, including where a future metric goes.

decisions.decision: Database design gate PASSED on re-run after the module change. charging schema, tesla_id BIGINT NOT NULL, nullable capacity plus TWO counts: candidate_count (RD2-valid rows, before the delta gate) and sample_count (after the gate, the slice the median used). UNIQUE (tesla_id, effective_period) serves both read and upsert; no separate CREATE INDEX. The seam becomes packCapacityKWh(ctx, teslaID int64), changing two callers.
decisions.why: One read path and one write path, both served by the UNIQUE btree. Two counts separate 'no valid charges' from 'charged often but always too small' — otherwise a NULL month needs a hand query to explain.

decisions.decision: analytics.vehicle_monthly_metrics is deferred until a second monthly metric exists. Recorded as backlog #29.
decisions.why: Today it would hold one column, copied from charging, that nothing reads. It earns its place when a metric genuinely spans modules.

decisions.decision: Making charge_sessions.tesla_id NOT NULL is its own ticket, not part of MAG-32. Recorded as backlog #30.
decisions.why: The mirror sets it to NULL on purpose when a VIN is unregistered, so this is a behaviour change over irreplaceable history, not a schema tidy-up.

decisions.decision: Added a rule to ai/architecture.md section 2: 'First ask where the fact belongs, not how to break the cycle', with a microservice test and RM52 as the worked precedent.
decisions.why: The owner wants modules that could become services. A module that can become a service owns its data and the facts derived from it.

decisions.decision: candidate_count added to the table at the design gate. sample_count keeps its post-gate meaning (tier 1 design D1, confirmed). A row is stored only when candidate_count >= 1.
decisions.why: Without it, a month of 20 small top-ups looks identical to a month with nothing measurable. The migration was still unwritten, so the column cost nothing; later it would be a migration.

decisions.decision: cmd/monthly-capacity is LOCAL ONLY. It is not added to the Dockerfile and does not ship to the VPS image. No backlog entry either.
decisions.why: The Dockerfile builds each binary by name, so shipping it is extra scope. Prod backfill is a separate problem the owner chose not to open now.

decisions.decision: Add a new exported config.LoadDatabase(): loadDotEnv, require DATABASE_URL, nothing else. internal/config/ is granted to tier 3 for that file and its test.
decisions.why: config.Load fails without Tesla credentials this tool never uses. config.LoadMigration already set the precedent for a smaller loader.

budget.note: artifacts phase only: the withdrawn analytics attempt, the design rework, and the charging worker plus its rate-limited correction round

tiers.notes: Self-contained in charging. RD11's table, the RD3 estimator as a pure function, the job applying RD2 and grouping by tesla_id (RD5), and the new packCapacityKWh body with its two updated callers. No cross-module port.

budget.note: whole tier 2 implementation in one resumed session: 3 worker dispatches, 1 reviewer round, archive

tiers.notes: Step 4 of ProcessVehicleData (RD6), gated on the first day of the month in America/Bogota via internal/clock (RD7). Pure gate + thin wrapper. Task 2.4 added a zone-mismatch warning. Reviewer approved round 1, zero findings.
cmd/monthly-capacity (RD8) + make cmd-monthly-capacity (RD9) + wiring + structure docs + the vehicle-monthly-metrics KB guide (ticket item 4).
